BiblicalUsage: Yehovih is the same name of the LORD, written with the vowel points of Elohim. In Genesis 15:2, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the LORD's name carries His promise, and I call on Him by the name He gave.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
